meta.title: Post-auction negotiation counter offer is visible and actionable for vendor after Dutch auction
gaps: Complete the Dutch auction before raising the counter offer; the prepared state is fixed and has no Dutch-auction completion step.
Verify that the vendor's Reject and Modify controls are actionable; no catalog step performs those vendor responses.
Verify successful resolution of RCA tickets 2946863624, 337415503568, and 208623700706.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Complete the Dutch auction before raising the counter offer; the prepared state is fixed and has no Dutch-auction completion step.; Verify that the vendor's Reject and Modify controls are actionable; no catalog step performs those vendor responses.; Verify successful resolution of RCA tickets 2946863624, 337415503568, and 208623700706.

steps.note: Open the prepared converted-auction event's pricing Responses screen as required for this state.
Open the buyer comparison grid where a counter offer can be initiated for the active vendor bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer at the required price of 85 per unit.
Assert that the buyer grid marks the vendor bid as having a counter offer initiated.
Switch to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the auction pricing round in the vendor portal so the pending counter offer is displayed.
Assert that the vendor has a visible control to accept the counter offer.
Assert that the vendor view visibly identifies the pending counter offer.
Check for the expected vendor rejection option; its exact control label is not catalog-confirmed.
Check for the expected vendor modification option; its exact control label is not catalog-confirmed.
